train_reward_model_gaudi: train a reward model on Gaudi2 using GaudiRewardTrainer with LoRA fine-tuning on paired preference data
configure_gaudi_training_args: create GaudiTrainingArguments with habana lazy mode, bf16, gradient accumulation, and deepspeed support
setup_lora_peft_config: create a LoraConfig for sequence classification and wrap the model with get_peft_model for parameter-efficient fine-tuning
preprocess_reward_dataset: tokenize paired responses into input_ids_j and input_ids_k columns using a batched preprocess function
compute_reward_accuracy_metric: compute accuracy by comparing rewards_j vs rewards_k predictions using numpy argmax and the evaluate library
